summary: Official Nghệ An land-information procedure and national geospatial/land systems were investigated. No anonymous, city-bounded parcel ID plus geometry response was verified. This is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.

scopeLimits: No city boundary or complete Vinh coverage was established.
No exact-point hit/miss was used as an absence claim.
No parcel geometry or source-specific attributes were retained.
National/general agency prose is not treated as proof of a local open registry adapter.
nativeIdentityPolicy: No native parcel identity was observed; no synthetic identity was created. If a future public response is found, retain only one stable native identity in GeoJSON properties and document native field mapping here.
